physical_scope: Current executor: one own-workcell parcel_i to receiver_i per robot. Two jobs per robot are a logical scheduling test until a physical executor supports them.
semantic_cases: Reject the complete mission before execution if any grounded object/destination pair is unsupported by every supplied robot capability.
Do not assign a cross-workcell pair to a nearby robot that cannot execute it.
A successful first job unlocks its dependent second job; both use current observed positions, not stored initial positions.
A failed job does not implicitly retry and cannot unlock dependent work.
A second job with stale or uncertain object or destination evidence remains blocked until a fresh observation arrives.
Why-waiting answers expose the actual checked compiler gates, scene revision and event time; no check means unknown.
ALG.0, ALG.1 and ALG.2 select identical jobs under identical positions, capabilities and gate inputs.

ablation.name: freshness_admission
ablation.input: Recorded sensor-derived scene with the query clock advanced past max_age, preserving measured positions and provenance; separately refresh actual available observations.
ablation.baseline: Same dispatch and capabilities with max_age increased to admit intentionally stale observations.
ablation.claim_boundary: Offline admission check, not a physical success or safety comparison. A later matched camera-outage physical evaluation requires separate traces.
